bifurcation.note: Declared before any reference was opened. The two sets are disjoint and are never combined into one UI number, which would be CC-5. Every Morrowind plate cited in this verdict — REF-A12b inventory, journal, dialogue; REF-A12's openmw_dialogue_window.layout and openmw_hud.layout — is cited ONLY under ART_DIRECTION, for arrangement, colour family, materials and populated density. No 2002-era or OpenMW capture is cited anywhere as evidence of a FIDELITY metric; the only fidelity figures in this verdict (textRenderPath, text_raster_scale, and the ui-metrics self-test) come from the running build and from a synthetic test pattern. NO CC-7 SENTENCE APPEARS: at no point is a rendering-quality measurement excused by the interface's art direction.

biggest_gap.what: The out-of-combat HUD has 1 of its 6 required elements, and the one element it has is in the wrong half of the screen. RI-UIX07 §B closes the world set at six: W1 bearing dial, W2 active-effect strip, W3 sneak state, W4 condition and charge marks on the quick slots, W5 place-name announcement, W6 breath meter. Only W1 exists — W2, W3, W4, W5 and W6 appear in no element-kind vocabulary on any frame captured, in any mode, across four separate runs. And W1's rect is [1782, 84, 96, 96], so y + h = 180 against H/2 = 540: it sits wholly in the top half, where §D1 requires the bottom half and §D2 requires the bottom-right corner or the rail inboard of it. biggest_gap.why_it_matters: For the ninety minutes of every hour the player is not fighting, the screen tells them their stamina — which they did not need — and nothing about where they are, which is the only question a markerless world poses; and the one element that would answer it is in the corner where a modern action-RPG puts its minimap, which is the register the whole interface is trying to stay out of.

remedy.action: Move the dial, then build the missing five cheapest-first. (1) In game/src/ui/compass.js, dialGeometry() computes cy = max(84*s + r, margin + r) — the top edge. Recompute it against the bottom edge so the dial anchors bottom-right, and where RI-UIX01's quick slots (E5, currently [1728,888,150,150]) and equip-load gauge (E9, [1758,852,120,24]) already hold that corner, place the dial immediately inboard on the same bottom rail; add the D4 overlap assertion against every RI-UIX01 rect. (2) Build W4 next because it costs nothing: a condition rule under the weapon slot and a cast-chance rule under the spell slot, drawn INSIDE E5's existing 150x150 rect, adding zero screen coverage — Morrowind draws both and they are visible as thin red rules in REF-A12c. ON THE DIAL, because it looks wrong and is not. At 5x the bearing dial reads S at the lubber line with SE to the upper-left and SW to the upper-right, which appears to be a mirrored compass.
